review_notes: Bangladeshi ordinary passport holders require an entry visa for mainland Vietnam; the electronic visa is available to citizens of all countries and territories. The Immigration Department portal confirms the e-Visa is for foreigners outside Vietnam, valid up to 90 days, single or multiple entry, and requires a valid passport. The Vietnam Tourism authority states passport validity of at least six months and two blank pages. The Phu Quoc 30-day exemption is a narrow island-only exception and does not authorize onward travel to mainland Vietnam without a visa. Fee is non-refundable; application and entry remain subject to approval. Checked 2026-11-14.
